reason: SandBase Harness is primarily an AI-agent orchestration runtime providing persistent sessions, sandboxed tool execution, MCP integration, memory, credentials, and audit or replay features through a local console and API.

summaries.zh: SandBase Harness 是一个本地优先的 AI 智能体编排运行时，提供持久会话、沙箱工具执行、MCP 集成、记忆、凭据管理以及审计回放功能。
summaries.en: SandBase Harness is a local-first AI agent orchestration runtime for persistent sessions, sandboxed tool execution, MCP integration, memory, credential management, and audit replay.

capabilities: Runs AI agent sessions through a local or self-hosted runtime
Executes generated code and tools in local, Docker, Kubernetes, or worker sandboxes
Provides MCP toolsets and permission policies
Stores session data, memory, files, credentials, and audit or replay records
Connects to configured model provider APIs
